rows.concrete_observation: Read entire pinned EntityRockyRoller including native goals/tick/rolling transitions. Actual hurt has no rolling-state denial: if not moving, source not exact MAGIC, direct entity Living and not same creature class, may thorns2 unless exact EXPLOSION or attacker.hurtMarked; own method always returns super.hurt regardless thorns result. Native tick rolling/angry/alive collision loop calls hurt then launch unconditionally; launch only checks onGround and directly push using squared horizontal distance clamped0.001. No hurt success gate or effect acceptance. isInvulnerableTo compares DamageSource object equals string fallingStalactite before parent, not damage-type key/tag; source-specific behaviour cannot be proven from a string label. Two-argument causeFallDamage returnsfalse but has no Override annotation; no engine signature/caller read, so do not assert actual native fall immunity. Rolling server writes ROLLING synched flag through rollFor/handleRoll, max duration and cooldown; earthquake adds effects ignoring addEffect result, sets local flag for any qualifying candidate or scheduled falling blocks and emits roar/sound from that flag, not effect acceptance.

Do not infer acceptance from a sound conditioned on candidate presence, and do not assume a legacy-shaped method is a native override without caller verification.
